faq.a: We are an export company that works with Jaipur workshops. You deal with one team for pricing, packing, and shipping papers.
Our standard range is for display and gift use, not for serving food. Tell us if you need food contact items and we will quote separately.
Most bulk orders leave from Mundra port in Gujarat. We state the shipping term clearly on your quote. We can include sea freight to your port when you ask.
Sample availability, courier method, cost, and customs documents are confirmed for the product and destination. Written approval can establish the production reference.

faq.q: Who handles EU or UK product rules?
faq.a: You import into your country. We give you product details and any test reports we have so your compliance team can approve the line.
An inspection and production photo plan can be agreed in the order. The scope must be written before production.
Mixed SKU planning depends on the products, maker constraints, packing, and total order value. Share your target range for review.

faq.q: Can you quote FOB or CIF?
faq.a: Yes, those quote bases can be discussed with a named port. EXW, FCA, and FAS may also be considered where suitable.
Freight coordination can be discussed according to destination, volume, shipping method, and the agreed Incoterm.
Applicable documents may include a commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, certificate of origin where required, and agreed labels.

faq.q: Can you provide an HS code?
faq.a: A planning tariff hint may be shared, but final classification should be verified for the exact product and destination.
Carton quantity, dimensions, and weight are provided only after product measurement and packing validation.

faq.q: Can you develop a custom product?
faq.a: Selected products can be investigated through the Jaat Sourcing Desk. Feasibility, sample cost, MOQ, and timing are reviewed before commitment.

faq.q: Can I send a reference product?
faq.a: Yes. Send a photo, drawing, catalogue page, moodboard, or specification with quantity, destination, and target timing.
Visits can be discussed after launch and after the product brief and relevant maker arrangements are clear.
Use the same SKU and approved specification. Availability, material, finish, quantity, and timing are reconfirmed for every order.
The sample and written specification define the reference. Any checks or inspection level must be agreed in the order.

faq.q: What happens if goods arrive damaged?
faq.a: The reporting window, evidence, insurance, and remedy must be agreed in the commercial terms before shipment.

faq.q: How do you handle handmade variation?
faq.a: Natural variation is explained before approval. Commercially important dimensions, colours, finishes, and tolerances should be written into the specification.

steps.title: Send your brief
steps.body: Share products, approximate quantities, destination market, required timing, and any customization.

steps.title: Review options and quotation
steps.body: We review sourcing possibilities, planning MOQ, timing, and the requested quote basis.

steps.title: Approve samples
steps.body: Where sampling is suitable, the approved sample becomes the production reference.

steps.title: Confirm specifications
steps.body: Material, finish, intended use, quantity, packing, and relevant requirements are agreed in writing.

steps.title: Coordinate production and checks
steps.body: The order is sourced or produced and checked against the agreed reference and requirements.

steps.title: Pack and prepare documents
steps.body: Packing and applicable commercial documents are prepared for the agreed shipment.

steps.title: Ship and plan the next order
steps.body: Shipment responsibilities follow the agreed Incoterm. Stable SKU references support future enquiries.
